sections.title: Everything from this unit, in one relationship
sections.content: Describing a real friendship chains what you already know from this unit: barátnő/ismerős, nem csak... hanem... is, ismerkedik, keresztül, kijön, egymással, and barátkozik/nyitott.

items.spanish: Petra nem csak kolléganőm, hanem a barátnőm is.
items.english: Petra isn't just my colleague, she's also my friend.

items.spanish: Jól kijövünk egymással, és sokat beszélünk.
items.english: We get along well with each other, and we talk a lot.

sections.content: This is the same kind of sentence-chaining you already used for schedules in Unit 2 and family stories in Unit 3 — new vocabulary each time, same skill of linking short sentences into a fuller picture.
